The incident report indicates that the search function has been failing on the production site since this morning, affecting all users, and there is no workaround available. According to the provided rules:

- P1 is for a production system where all users are affected and there is no workaround.
- P2 is for a production system where only some users are affected and there is no workaround.
- P3 is for anything else, such as a non-production system or where a workaround exists.

Since this incident affects all users on a production system and there is no workaround, it fits the criteria for a P1 priority.

Label: P1
